newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton sees rise in Asian revenue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton sees rise in Asian revenue.

text.p: Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it expected a 40 percent increase in sales revenue from its Asian division, Leighton Asia Ltd, in the year ending June 30, 1997, driven by increased activity in Hong Kong.
"We anticipate a 40 percent increase this year," Leighton Asia Ltd managing director John Faulkner told Reuters.
Leighton Asia turned over A$370 million in revenue in 1995/96, with the group's total Asian revenue amounting to about 20 percent of total 1995/96 turnover of A$2.4 billion.

Outlining the Asian divisions business in Hong Kong, where it is helping to build the terriotry's new airport, Faulkner said Leighton Asia had over 100 contracts and about A$500 million worth of work in hand.
